source: make a game where U run around and try and match the theme and there's different sections

image_prompt.text: A floor split into even, clearly identifiable sections players run between to pick the one matching the theme
A central gathering area players return to between rounds
each section dressed to a distinct theme so it is recognisable at a glance

layout_placement.text: Detection regions over each section that register whether the player picked the one matching the theme

notes: Read as a run-to-the-matching-section round game. If match the theme instead means dressing an avatar to a prompt, this is Roleplay and Avatar Sim with a runway shape and the whole layout changes.
No option covers a section being themed rather than merely distinct, so that was carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: What does matching the theme actually mean - running to the right section, wearing the right outfit, or collecting the right items?
What kinds of themes are the sections - biomes, colours, holidays, something else?

coverage_missing.ask: What does matching the theme actually mean - running to the right section, wearing the right outfit, or collecting the right items?
Is this a round-based minigame with a lobby, or one continuous space?
What kinds of themes are the sections - biomes, colours, holidays, something else?
How many sections should there be?

answers.ask: What does matching the theme actually mean - running to the right section, wearing the right outfit, or collecting the right items?
answers.answer: Matching the theme means running to the section that matches the current theme.

answers.ask: What kinds of themes are the sections - biomes, colours, holidays, something else?
answers.answer: Make the sections different biomes, like forest, desert, snow, and beach.
